summary: PCRX honesty profile is mixed but tilts negative. The framework's strongest finding is Mode B: management's OWN Q3 2024 quantitative impairment model wrote off 100% of goodwill ($163.2M) because their own DCF put enterprise fair value below carrying value, a self-disclosed franchise impairment driven by the July 2024 FDA generic approval and the August 2024 invalidation of the EXPAREL '495 patent. The FY2024 10-K (signed Feb 26, 2025) OMITS the Jan 13, 2025 Alvarez securities class action alleging Pacira concealed material adverse EXPAREL-patent facts — a notable Mode B gap, since the company had six weeks of notice. The 5x30 'double-digit CAGR' target launched Jan 2025 is already contradicted by Q1 2025's +1.1% growth print, which itself includes the NOPAIN/J-code catalyst they have been pointing to. Auditor relationship clean, going-concern absent, insider activity benign, refinancing path bounded. Net: distress is structural (78% revenue concentration in a patent-impaired product) but disclosure is mostly complete; the framework flags one severe omission (class-action timing) and the magnitude of the underlying business deterioration.
